Another pupil Keen on Driving with a fantastic first time pass for Eddie! 

Eddie had a great drive and passed with only 3️⃣ driver faults! 😀🚦🛑🥳🎉 

Good to see all the hard work paying off! 

First pupil I've taught from Belfast and I'm going to miss those talks about Ireland as well as the Irish accent 😂

Good luck with your new job down south! And you can now relax and enjoy your holiday next week! 😀
